name: Beadnell Bay Camping and Caravanning Club Site
accommodation: Grass and hardstanding pitches, with or without electric, plus jumbo pitches
beachAccess: Just across the road from the beach
confirmedFeatures: Toilets, showers including one for wetsuits, accessible facilities, washing machines, dishwashing, shop, Wi-Fi, play area, motorhome service point
overview: A Camping and Caravanning Club site directly across the road from Beadnell Bay, a short walk from the village. It has grass and hardstanding pitches, a shop and a wetsuit shower. The site is open from late March to late October, and pets are welcome.
surfTripFit: Across the road from the bay with a dedicated wetsuit shower, it is about as practical as surf camping gets here.
